suricata_conf_path.description: Path to the suricata main configuration file

sources.description:
List of sources to enable. Each source is a map with 'name' and 'url'. For items definition, see 'source_item'.
Items: source_item -> {type: object, properties: {name: {type: string}, url: {type: string}}}

disabled_sources.description: List of source names to explicitly disable

offline.description: Run offline using most recent cached rules
